other_failure_modes.name: Unaligned categorical encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent converts string columns to categorical types independently for the train and test sets using `.astype('category')`. This causes pandas to assign integer codes based on the unique values present in each respective dataset. Since train and test sets may have different unique values or distinct sorted orders, the integer codes will mismatch, leading to incorrect feature representation and severely degraded predictions on the test set.

summary: The agent successfully implements a standard LightGBM regression pipeline with 5-fold cross-validation, but misses several best practices in data preparation. Most critically, it independently encodes categorical variables in the train and test sets, which will misalign the underlying integer codes LightGBM relies on, drastically harming test set performance. Furthermore, it lacks explicit data cleaning and feature engineering, relying exclusively on raw features and the model's native capabilities.
